correctness.rationale: Verified the exact Kummer pullback exponent matrix A M over F_p; independence of coordinate classes gives vanishing iff Abar Mbar=0. Its kernel has dimension r-rho, so modulo p the integer lattice image of M has rank <=r-rho, and Smith normal form forces at least rho p-divisible invariant factors, hence degree divisible by p^rho. A unimodular lift of an adapted F_p basis (using SL_r(Z)->SL_r(F_p) for r>=2) followed by diag(p I_rho,I) realizes determinant exactly p^rho; the r=1, rho=0 and rho=r cases are straightforward. The statement is restricted to finite etale monomial covers on a coordinate torus where p is invertible and the coordinate Kummer classes remain independent; arbitrary covers not addressed. Independent bounded determinant searches for p=3,5 and four 2x2 matrices reproduce p^rho including dependent and independent rows. Finite search does not prove the lattice theorem.
residual_risks: Relies on linearly independent coordinate Kummer classes and torus-domain finite etaleness.
Minimality is only among monomial covers, not all finite etale or ramified covers.

value.rationale: Despite being an elementary Smith normal form application, the invariant is a precise natural optimization problem arising when several Tate-parameter Kummer classes are killed simultaneously by monomial finite etale covers. The formula distinguishes duplicate/dependent degenerations from genuinely independent directions and specifies minimal covering cost p^rho, which a researcher choosing simultaneous covers can use directly. It is a motivated exact invariant with non-implied numerical answer relative to the number s of curves, not an arbitrary finite slice. No claim to a new general theorem or deep Hodge machinery is made.
residual_risks: An algebraist may regard the exact formula as routine Kummer plus Smith normal form; its mathematical significance is deliberately narrow.
No general finite-cover, nonmonomial, or unrelated-sheaf splitting theorem.

final_claim: For an odd prime p, independent coordinate Kummer classes kappa_j and exponent matrix A over integers, the minimum degree |det M| among full-rank integral monomial torus covers for which all pullbacks of alpha_i=sum_j a_ij kappa_j vanish is p^rho, rho=rank_Fp(A mod p).
limitations: The theorem assumes independent coordinate Kummer classes and only optimizes finite etale monomial covers.
